title: BAS-VLA: Task-Semantic Action Calibration for VLA Models
titleZh: BAS-VLA：面向视觉语言动作模型的任务语义动作校准
short_description: BAS-VLA calibrates a frozen vision-language-action policy to stay stable when appearance changes and adapt when task semantics change. Paired clean, task-preserving, and semantic-breaking examples train a lightweight residual calibrator, while a selective visual auxiliary helps correct appearance-induced action drift in simulated and real robot manipulation.
shortDescriptionZh: BAS-VLA 为冻结的视觉语言动作策略加入轻量动作校准：外观变化时保持行为稳定，任务语义变化时及时调整动作。方法利用原始、语义保持与语义改变的配对样本训练残差校准器，并按需引入视觉辅助，提升仿真与真实机器人操作的可靠性。
thumbnailAlt: BAS-VLA framework for task-preserving and semantic-breaking action calibration
thumbnailAltZh: BAS-VLA 针对语义保持与语义改变的动作校准框架
